passage.title: Summer Water Restrictions
passage.body: Peringatan: Musim kemarau telah tiba. Air siap pakai akan dihilangkan. Air keran hanya untuk keperluan minum. Mohon gunakan dengan bijak. Terima kasih.

items.stem: What is the word for "water" in the notice?
items.explanation: The word for "water" in the notice is **air**. The notice mentions **air** putih and **air** keran, indicating that **air** refers to water. The other options refer to sun (**matahari**), heat (**panas**), and season (**musim**).

passage.title: Forest Fire Safety Menu
passage.body:
Hari Ini: Menu Makanan dan Minuman untuk Pemadam Kebakaran
Nasi Goreng, Sate Ayam, Es Teh, Es Jeruk

items.stem: What is the purpose of 'makanan dan minuman' in the menu?
choices: To provide food and drink to firefighters
To serve food to the public
items.explanation: The menu is for a forest fire safety event, so the purpose of 'makanan dan minuman' is to provide food and drink to firefighters, as indicated by the context of the event.

passage.title: New Road Safety Law Schedule
passage.body:
Undang-Undang Baru tentang Keselamatan Jalan Raya
Tanggal: 1 Januari 2023
Mulai berlaku: tiga bulan setelah tanggal tersebut
Tujuan: Meningkatkan keselamatan di jalan raya

items.stem: When will the new road safety law go into effect?
items.explanation: The text states that the law will go into effect 'tiga bulan setelah tanggal ini', which means 'three months after this date'.

passage.title: Port Visit Announcement
passage.body: Selamat datang di Pulau Seribu. Kedatangan: 10 Januari. Pelabuhan: Kota Tua. Waktu: 08.00-17.00. Kunjungan terbuka bagi umum.

items.stem: What is the name of the ship coming to the port?
items.explanation: The name of the ship is explicitly mentioned as "Pulau Seribu" in the text: "Selamat datang kapal Pulau Seribu."

passage.title: Earthquake Relief Center
passage.body:
PUSAT PENYALURAN BANTUAN GEMPA

Buka dari pukul 8 pagi hingga 17.00

Untuk mendapatkan makanan, air minum, dan obat-obatan

Mohon untuk berbaris dengan teratur

Terima kasih atas kerjasama Anda

items.stem: What does "bantuan" mean here?
items.explanation: The correct answer is "a kind of help", because the sign says "Pusat Bantuan Gempa", which means "Earthquake Relief Center", indicating that "bantuan" refers to help or aid. The other options are not mentioned or implied in the text.

passage.title: Explore Bali's Beauty Again
passage.body: Hotel Bali Indah menyambut kembali pariwisata dengan penawaran menarik. Dapatkan diskon 30% untuk pemesanan kamar hingga akhir bulan ini. Nikmati fasilitas premium dan pelayanan terbaik kami. Buru-buru, penawaran ini hanya berlaku untuk tamu mancanegara. Jangan lewatkan kesempatan untuk menikmati keindahan Bali kembali. Pesan sekarang di www.hotelbalindah.com.

items.stem: What is the purpose of the discount mentioned in the text?
choices: To encourage people to stay at the hotel longer
items.explanation: The text states 'untuk menarik wisatawan internasional' (to attract international visitors), indicating that the discount is aimed at encouraging more foreign tourists to visit Bali.

items.stem: What does 'pulih' mean here?
items.explanation: The text uses 'pulih' in the phrase 'menyambut pulih pariwisata' (welcoming the recovery of tourism), which means that 'pulih' refers to the process of tourism getting better after a difficult period.

items.stem: Why was this announcement written?
choices: To encourage tourism recovery in Bali
To inform about new hotel regulations
To announce a special cultural event
To promote a new tourist attraction
items.explanation: The text mentions 'menyambut pulih pariwisata' (welcoming the recovery of tourism) and provides information about discounts and special packages, indicating that the purpose is to encourage tourism recovery in Bali.

passage.title: Tourism Reopens on Java
passage.body: Pemerintah Jawa membuka kembali pariwisata. Semua wisatawan dapat kembali mengunjungi tempat-tempat menarik di sini. Namun, semua harus mematuhi peraturan yang berlaku. Jaga jarak, pakai masker, dan cuci tangan. Nikmati liburan yang aman dan menyenangkan!

items.stem: What is the main message of the text?
choices: All tourist attractions are open again.
Java's tourism is now allowed to reopen.
Tourism will reopen in the next month.
Tourists must follow new safety guidelines.
items.explanation: The main message is that tourism is now allowed to reopen, as stated in 'Pemerintah Jawa membuka kembali pariwisata.' The other choices are not mentioned or are incorrect according to the text.

items.stem: What does 'peraturan' mean here?
items.explanation: The word 'peraturan' is used to mean 'rules' or 'regulations' in the context of the text: 'Semua harus patuhi peraturan yang berlaku.'

passage.title: Witness the Launch of Satria
passage.body: Pantai Pasir Putih, Bali! Mari kita menonton peluncuran satelit baru, Satria! Tanggal 15 Maret, pukul 15.00 WITA. Tempat terbaik untuk menyaksikan peluncuran ini. Bawa keluarga dan teman-teman! Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, hubungi 0361-123456.

items.stem: What is Satria?
items.explanation: The text states that Satria is a 'satelit baru' (new satellite).

items.stem: What does 'menantikan' mean here?
items.explanation: The text uses 'menantikan' to indicate that people are waiting for and watching the launch of Satria.

passage.title: A New Way to Drive
passage.body: Pindah ke mobil listrik sekarang dan nikmati manfaatnya! Kami menawarkan diskon 20% untuk mobil listrik baru kami. Mobil listrik kami hemat energi, ramah lingkungan, dan mudah dioperasikan. Jangan lewatkan kesempatan ini untuk mengurangi jejak karbon Anda. Datangi showroom kami hari ini juga!

items.stem: What discount does the advertisement offer on the new electric cars?
items.explanation: The advertisement states 'Diskon 20% untuk mobil listrik baru!' which means '20% discount for new electric cars!'.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of this advertisement?
choices: To offer a discount on new electric cars
To explain how electric cars work
To inform about the benefits of electric cars
To announce a new law about electric cars
items.explanation: The main purpose is to offer a discount on new electric cars, as indicated by the phrase 'Diskon 20% untuk mobil listrik baru!'.

items.stem: What does 'hemat energi' mean here?
items.explanation: The phrase 'hemat energi' is used to describe the electric cars, indicating that they save energy.

passage.title: New Bus Route Announcement
passage.body: Kami bangga mengumumkan rute bus terbaru kami mulai 15 Desember. Rute baru ini akan mempercepat perjalanan dari Stasiun Purwakarta ke Pasar Baru. Bus akan beroperasi setiap hari mulai pukul 6 pagi hingga 8 malam. Harganya terjangkau untuk semua penumpang. Nikmati perjalanan yang lebih nyaman dan cepat dengan kami!

items.stem: What is the word in the announcement that means "new" here?
items.explanation: The correct answer is "terbaru". The text says "rute bus terbaru", which means "the newest bus route".

items.stem: What is the purpose of the announcement?
choices: To announce a new bus route
items.explanation: The correct answer is "To announce a new bus route". The text says "Kami bangga untuk mengumumkan rute bus terbaru kami", which means "We are proud to announce our newest bus route".

passage.title: New Terminal at Kualanamu International Airport
passage.body: Terminal baru di Bandar Udara Internasional Kualanamu akan dibuka pada 15 Mei. Terminal baru ini dirancang untuk meningkatkan kenyamanan dan efisiensi bagi penumpang. Semua penerbangan akan dipindah ke terminal baru secara bertahap. Pada awalnya, hanya beberapa maskapai penerbangan yang akan menggunakan terminal baru, dan kemudian semua penerbangan akan dipindah secara total. Kami mengundang semua penumpang untuk menikmati fasilitas baru yang tersedia di terminal baru kami. Tim kami siap untuk membantu dalam proses transisi ini.

items.stem: What is the main idea of this announcement?
choices: A new terminal at Kualanamu International Airport will open next month.
All flights will be moved to the new terminal immediately.
Passengers should expect significant delays during the transition.
The old terminal will be closed permanently.
items.explanation: The main idea is clearly stated in the first sentence: "Terminal baru di Bandar Udara Internasional Kualanamu akan dibuka pada 15 Mei." The other options present details or inferences that are not the main focus of the announcement.

items.stem: When will the new terminal at Kualanamu International Airport open?
items.explanation: The opening date is explicitly mentioned in the text: "Terminal baru di Bandar Udara Internasional Kualanamu akan dibuka pada 15 Mei."

items.stem: In the text, what does "pindah" mean?
items.explanation: The word "pindah" is used in the context of moving flights to the new terminal: "Semua penerbangan akan dipindah ke terminal baru." This indicates that "pindah" means "to move" in this context.

passage.title: Youth Exchange Program Strengthens Ties Between Indonesia and Malaysia
passage.body: Program pertukaran budaya antara Indonesia dan Malaysia akan diperluas. Kementerian Pendidikan Indonesia dan Kementerian Pendidikan Malaysia telah setuju untuk menambah jumlah peserta program ini. Selain itu, program juga akan dilanjutkan selama satu bulan lagi. Peserta akan mengikuti bengkel budaya, belajar tentang kesenian dan tradisi masing-masing, serta berkunjung ke tempat-tempat bersejarah. Program ini diharapkan dapat memperkuat hubungan antara kedua negara. 'Kami berharap program ini dapat meningkatkan pemahaman dan persahabatan antara pemuda Indonesia dan Malaysia,' kata Menteri Pendidikan Indonesia. Program baru akan dimulai pada bulan Oktober ini.

items.stem: What is the main idea of the text?
choices: The Indonesian and Malaysian governments are planning a new infrastructure project.
A new trade agreement has been signed between Indonesia and Malaysia.
A cultural exchange program between Indonesia and Malaysia is being expanded.
Indonesian and Malaysian students are organizing a joint protest.
items.explanation: The main idea is that a cultural exchange program between Indonesia and Malaysia is being expanded. This is evident from the text stating that 'Program pertukaran budaya antara Indonesia dan Malaysia akan diperluas' and mentioning the involvement of students and educators from both countries.

items.stem: What is one of the activities planned for the exchange program?
items.explanation: One of the activities planned for the exchange program is attending cultural workshops. The text mentions that 'Peserta akan mengikuti bengkel budaya' and 'belajar tentang kesenian dan tradisi masing-masing'.

items.stem: What does 'memperluas' mean here?
items.explanation: 'Memperluas' means 'to expand' in this context. The text states that the exchange program 'akan diperluas', indicating that it will be expanded to include more participants and activities.

passage.title: Bank Indonesia Raises Interest Rates
passage.body: Bank Indonesia telah menaikkan suku bunga untuk mengatasi inflasi yang meningkat. Pengumuman ini dilakukan setelah pertemuan Dewan Gubernur Bank Indonesia. Suku bunga dasar (BI Rate) sekarang adalah 4,5%. Naiknya suku bunga ini diharapkan bisa menahan inflasi dari semakin meningkat. Dengan naiknya suku bunga, biaya pinjaman akan lebih mahal. Ini bisa memengaruhi pembelian rumah, mobil, atau bisnis. Bank Indonesia juga berharap dengan naiknya suku bunga, investasi akan lebih banyak ke Indonesia. Ini karena uang asing akan mencari suku bunga yang lebih tinggi.

items.stem: What is the main topic of the text?
choices: The decision by Bank Indonesia to raise interest rates
The effects of inflation on the economy
The impact of interest rates on personal savings
The history of interest rate changes in Indonesia
items.explanation: The main topic of the text is the decision by Bank Indonesia to raise interest rates. This is clearly stated in the first sentence: "Bank Indonesia telah menaikkan suku bunga."

items.stem: According to the text, what is the main reason for the increase in interest rates?
choices: To encourage people to save more money
To combat the rising inflation rate
To increase the value of the Indonesian rupiah
items.explanation: The text states that the main reason for the increase in interest rates is to combat the rising inflation rate: "untuk mengatasi inflasi yang meningkat."

items.stem: What does the word "menahan" mean here?
items.explanation: In this context, "menahan" means "to prevent" or "to curb". The text uses it to describe the goal of preventing inflation from getting worse: "menahan inflasi dari semakin meningkat."

passage.title: Indonesia Tightens Seat Belt Laws
passage.body: Pemerintah Indonesia telah menerapkan undang-undang baru tentang keselamatan lalu lintas. Undang-undang ini memerlukan semua penumpang mobil untuk selalu memakai sabuk pengaman. Hal ini berlaku baik untuk penumpang di bagian depan maupun belakang. Pelanggaran akan dikenakan denda hingga 500.000 rupiah. Tujuan utama dari undang-undang ini adalah untuk mengurangi jumlah korban luka-luka dan kematian dalam kecelakaan lalu lintas. Pemerintah berharap dengan adanya undang-undang ini, masyarakat akan lebih sadar tentang pentingnya keselamatan lalu lintas.

items.stem: What is the main topic of this text?
choices: A proposal to build more roads
A new tax on car ownership
A change in the speed limit for cars
A new rule about seat belts in Indonesia
items.explanation: The text discusses a new law about seat belts, specifically that they will now be required for all car passengers. The other options are not mentioned in the text.

items.stem: What is the penalty for not wearing a seat belt under the new law?
choices: A fine of up to 500,000 rupiah
A fine of up to 1 million rupiah
A jail sentence of up to 6 months
items.explanation: The text states that the penalty for not wearing a seat belt is a fine of up to 500,000 rupiah. The other options are not mentioned as penalties in the text.

items.stem: In the text, what does 'penumpang' mean?
items.explanation: The text uses 'penumpang' to refer to those who are not driving the car, i.e., passengers. The other options are not correct in this context.

passage.title: Indonesian Navy Ships Visit Timor-Leste
passage.body: Kapal-kapal angkatan laut Indonesia akan berlabuh di pelabuhan Dili, Timor-Leste, untuk latihan. Kegiatan ini akan berlangsung selama tiga hari, mulai hari Senin. Tujuan kunjungan ini adalah untuk meningkatkan kerja sama antara angkatan laut Indonesia dan Timor-Leste. Selain latihan, awak kapal juga akan mengikuti berbagai kegiatan sosial budaya dengan masyarakat setempat. Kegiatan ini diperkirakan akan berdampak positif bagi hubungan bilateral antara kedua negara.

items.stem: What is the main idea of the text?
choices: Indonesian navy ships are docking in Timor-Leste for maintenance.
Indonesian navy ships are delivering humanitarian aid to Timor-Leste.
Indonesian navy ships are participating in a joint military operation with Timor-Leste.
Indonesian navy ships are visiting Timor-Leste for training exercises.
items.explanation: The correct answer is that Indonesian navy ships are visiting Timor-Leste for training exercises. This is supported by the text stating: 'Kapal-kapal angkatan laut Indonesia akan berlabuh di pelabuhan Dili untuk latihan.'

items.stem: What is the name of the port in Timor-Leste where the Indonesian navy ships will dock?
items.explanation: The correct answer is Pelabuhan Dili. The text explicitly mentions: 'Kapal-kapal angkatan laut Indonesia akan berlabuh di pelabuhan Dili.'

items.stem: What does 'berlabuh' mean here?
items.explanation: The correct answer is 'to dock'. The text uses 'berlabuh' to indicate that the ships will dock at the port in Dili: 'Kapal-kapal angkatan laut Indonesia akan berlabuh di pelabuhan Dili.'
